say:0:1029229001:0.text: How can this place be empty? There isn't a single person here.
say:0:1029229001:0.source_cn: 这里竟然空荡荡的，一个人都没有？不可能，我不相信！

say:1:1029229002:0.text: Hmm, seems all those "true warriors" have all run off...
say:1:1029229002:0.source_cn: 呃，看起来“勇士”们都已经跑光了……

say:2:1029229003:0.text: Such a huge camp... Unbelievable... Hang on, I smell something—
say:2:1029229003:0.source_cn: 偌大一个营地，竟然连一个“真正的勇士”都不存在！等等，...

say:3:1029229004:0.text: There are two treasure thieves over there.
say:3:1029229004:0.source_cn: 那边好像有两个盗宝贼，过去问问情况吧。
say:3:1029229004:0.male: There are two treasure thieves over there.
say:3:1029229004:0.female: There are two treasure thieves over there.
